messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: SLO burn-rate (prod) exceeded threshold for 'request_latency_p95' in us-west-2. Paging on-call...
Maya Chen: ack. I'm on it. Seeing a bunch of 429-ish errors? Can someone grab logs/trace links?
Jon Patel: grabbing traces now. linking: https://traces.internal/redwood/trace/abcd1234
Jon Patel: initial look — spike coincides with large burst of short prompt requests to text-gen-3-small from a partner integration. KV cache miss rates spiked.
Maya Chen: ok that would increase tokens and drop throughput. Priya, can you spin up the live dashboard for SLO burn and cache hit rate?
Priya Rao: made a dashboard. https://grafana.internal/d/SLOburn/quickview
Priya Rao: screenshot pasted. We have very noisy single-window spikes that fire the burn alert even though overall budget for the hour is still ok.
Maya Chen: paging noise. I'm going to mute the lower-severity burn pager for now (will keep critical path pagers). Doing short suppress for 20m. /ops mute burn-pager severity=warning duration=20m
ops-bot: Suppression created by Maya Chen. Suppression ID sup-772. Expires in 20m.
Jon Patel: traced partner requests — they retried aggressively when they saw occasional 503s. Their retry backoff is too tight. Reached out to partner on support channel, asked them to pause traffic.
Eli Gomez: cherry-picked a quick fix on the batcher to re-enable prefix_kv caching for that model variant. Rolling prod patch to reduce load. Deploy started: deploy-2026-03-27-12:42
ops-bot: Deploy deploy-2026-03-27-12:42 started by Eli Gomez — 3/4 services healthy
Eli Gomez: deploy completed, performance trending back to normal.
Priya Rao: since this triggered a lot of noise, proposing we change the SLO burn alert to require sustained burn across multiple windows before paging. Current rule below:
```
(ALERT) SLO_BURN_WARNING if burn_rate > 0.5 for window 5m
page: true
severity: warning
```
Proposed rule:
```
(ALERT) SLO_BURN_WARN if (burn_rate > 0.8 and window >= 5m) OR (burn_rate > 0.3 and windows_sustained >= 3) 
page: true
severity: warning
```
Maya Chen: +1. Also add a second-tier pager only for >1.0 sustained or customer-impacting errors. We should reduce false positives from ephemeral spikes.
Jon Patel: I'll open a PR with the new alert expression and tests. Also adding an annotation that we only page if error_rate or latency contributes (avoid token-only cost spikes paging ops).
Priya Rao: created a quick dashboard tile for 'sustained burn windows' and added it to SLO ops folder.
oncall-rotations: important follow-ups: 1) change alert rule (jon), 2) add dashboard tile (priya), 3) update runbook with new paging criteria and suppression play (maya), 4) file infra ticket to audit partners' retry behavior (eli). Please tag INC-3245.
Eli Gomez: filed INC-3245 for partner retry audits and linked trace set. https://incidents.internal/INC-3245
Maya Chen: moving to handoff — Jon taking first responder for the next hour, I'll be available for escalations. Jon, accept.
Jon Patel: taking. Accepting handoff. I'll follow up with PR and a short post-incident note.
Priya Rao: I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to walk through dashboard and keep SLO owners in the loop.
Maya Chen: final note: we muted the warning pager but kept critical pages. Suppression will auto-expire; do not re-enable until paired mitigation is verified. Postmortem ticket PM-789 created; add details and timeline there.
ops-bot: Suppression sup-772 expired.
Jon Patel: PR merged with alert tuning: alert rule updated and tests added. See PR #4321
Maya Chen: thanks all. Closing thread when PR is in prod and postmortem updated. :white_check_mark:
